what: Planned single-call test expects REASON=validation-failed while the same plan says any validator nonzero advances the waterfall and all failed phases return validation-exhausted
scenario_or_breakage: The harness cannot satisfy both contracts without an unstated phase cap, so implementers may either skip the fallback or update the test incorrectly
suggested_fix: Resolve the contract: test the substring guard through the waterfall-exhausted case or define an explicit validator-only/phase-capped harness

what: The plan forces presence flags to true/false as executor selectors, overriding actual tool availability passed by review-core
scenario_or_breakage: In Codex-only or Cursor-unavailable environments the aggregator can still try Cursor, wait for a failed launch, then label an internal Claude fallback as the cursor phase
suggested_fix: Build the phase list from truthful availability and skip unavailable tools, or add an explicit dispatcher selector instead of lying through presence flags

what: The plan states aggregator-output.txt.phase1/.phase2/.phase3 matches dispatch output_for_phase naming, but dispatch uses the base path for phase1 and -phase2.txt/-phase3.txt for later internal phases
scenario_or_breakage: Tests and diagnostics will look for files that dispatch does not naturally produce, especially when internal fallback writes aggregator-output-phase3.txt
suggested_fix: After each outer phase, copy the candidate from ALL_OUTPUT_FILES into deterministic aggregator-output.txt.phaseN artifacts, and document those as aggregator-owned artifacts

what: The planned stub counter file uses $TMP inside the generated stub, but TMP is not exported and the stub runs under set -u
scenario_or_breakage: New waterfall stub kinds can fail with unbound variable before exercising aggregate-findings.sh
suggested_fix: Export TMP before invoking the stub, derive the counter path from dirname "$0", or bake the counter path into the generated stub intentionally

what: The review-core short-circuit is specified as placeholder observability rather than the exact panel-failed artifact contract
scenario_or_breakage: A minimal implementation may emit counts but skip empty accepted/rejected/OOS files, emit-tally isolation, parent artifact copies, or round-log flushing, leaving Step 5 summaries and logs inconsistent
suggested_fix: Specify a helper or exact mirrored block: create the empty artifacts, call emit_tally_with_failure_isolation, copy parent artifacts, flush_round_log, and emit the same file/count/panel/scout KVs as panel-failed
